title: ESL — Writing a Newspaper Article: Step-by-Step Guide
skills: identify the basic structure and features of a newspaper article
write clear headlines, leads, and supporting paragraphs
organize information by importance and relevance
adapt tone, detail, and language for a news audience
alignment_note: Provides a step-by-step introduction to writing newspaper articles, including headlines, leads, organization, and audience-focused reporting. Supports informational and journalistic writing, concise factual communication, text structure, and media literacy across high school English courses, with especially accessible reinforcement for multilingual learners.
